newsitem.title: UK: UK drug stocks up as they chase U.S. pharma sector.
newsitem.headline: UK drug stocks up as they chase U.S. pharma sector.

text.p: Shares in British pharmaceutical companies advanced on Wednesday as the sector followed the steep rise of U.S. drug stocks in New York.
"We are chasing the U.S. stocks. That's what it is basically", one trader said.

The S&P Pharmaceutical Index rose 4.6 percent in New York. The sector rebounded strongly as the Dow bounced back from Monday's losses and as U.S. investors moved into the sector, spurred by anticipated strong second-quarter earnings reports and general market bullishness on large-cap stocks, analysts said.
Glaxo Wellcome Plc gained 18p to 12.70-1/2 stg by 1025 GMT. Its New York ADRs rose $1-1/8 to 42-1/8.
SmithKline Beecham Plc was up 17p to 10.65-1/2 stg.
Kleinwort Benson said on Wednesday it preferred SmithKline to Glaxo, analysts at the brokerage declined to give further details.
Elsewhere in the sector, Zeneca Group Plc was lifted 25-1/2p to 19.19-1/2 stg.
